req.title: Delete player
req.statement: The system shall delete the specified player and respond with HTTP 204 when DELETE /players/{playerId} is called.

doc.reasoning: The DELETE /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} endpoint must return HTTP 204 on success, HTTP 404 when the player does not exist, and HTTP 422 or 404 for malformed path parameters. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — delete an existing player returns 204 and the player is gone; (2) negative NEG — delete a non-existent squad number returns 404; (3) boundary BVA — delete the lowest squad number (1) in the fixture; (4) STC — delete then re-delete the same player confirms state transition from exists→deleted→404; (5) DT — malformed (non-integer) squad number in path returns 422. Each test uses exact status-code assertions and verifies side-effects via a follow-up GET to kill constant-mutation and comparison-flip mutants.

tests.name: test_delete_existing_player_returns_204
preconditions: Player with squad_number=10 (Messi) exists in the database
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_existing_player_returns_204():
    r = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert r.status_code == 204
    assert r.content == b''
    r2 = client.get('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert r2.status_code == 404

test_delete_existing_player_returns_204()

tests.name: test_delete_player_no_body_in_response
preconditions: Player with squad_number=23 (D. Martinez) exists in the database
actions: Assert response body is empty (no JSON payload)
expected: HTTP 204 with empty body — not 200 with body, not 201
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_player_no_body_in_response():
    r = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/23')
    assert r.status_code == 204
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 201
    assert r.content == b''
    try:
        body = r.json()
        assert False, f'Expected empty body but got: {body}'
    except Exception:
        pass

test_delete_player_no_body_in_response()
